native_context: Registered-email change and account recovery binding
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Registered-email change and account recovery binding — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read authenticated change initiation, pending-address storage, confirmation token consumption and the address used for reset/login/notifications before confirmation.
controls.controlled_verification: As a controlled account owner, propose a second owned address and inspect whether unconfirmed data already becomes a recovery identity. Compare token account/address/purpose binding and a normal confirmation. Use only owned inboxes and synthetic accounts.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A pending address in an API response is not proof it receives recovery authority. Intentional notifications to both old and new addresses do not establish takeover.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Keep pending and verified identity separate and bind confirmation to the exact account/address transition. Retest expired/replaced pending changes, valid confirmation and recovery before/after it.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
